physical_shields.name: Lightweight Shield
physical_shields.description: Provides 18 Armor and has 200 Breakpoints. An Anti-Ballistics Shield that acts as mobile cover. The shield is titanium-A with a hardened plastic window to see through. The Shield covers 4 Locations for Normal sized Characters. Only up to 2 Attacks per Half Action when making Melee Attacks.

physical_shields.name: Anti-Ballistics Shield
physical_shields.description: Provides 20 Armor and has 300 Breakpoints. An Anti-Ballistics Shield that acts as mobile cover. The shield is titanium-A with a hardened plastic window to see through. The Shield covers 5 Locations for Normal sized Characters. One Attack per Half Action when making Melee Attacks.

physical_shields.name: Heavy Shield
physical_shields.description: A powerful shield that has 30 Armor and 400 Breakpoints. The Shield covers 5 Locations for Large sized Characters. One Attack per Half Action when making Melee Attacks. Stun (2) Special Rule. *Characters with 70+ Strength and 5 or more Mythic Strength may hold their [TH] Heavy Shield as [OH].

physical_shields.name: Superheavy Shield
physical_shields.description: A powerful shield that has 40 Armor and 500 Breakpoints. The Shield covers 5 Locations for Huge sized Characters. One Attack per Half Action when making Melee Attacks. Stun (2) Special Rule. *Characters with 80+ Strength and 5 or more Mythic Strength may hold their [TH] Superheavy Shield as [OH].

misc_weapons.name: Cable Cutters
misc_weapons.description: 30 Penalty to Hit against moving Characters. Common pair of large-scale cable cutters. Able to cut large chain links and other pieces of metal. More than strong enough to cut off a finger of any race. On Helpless or Stunned Characters that cannot fight back, Melee Attacks with Wire Cutters deal 2D10 +9 Damage, with 15 Pierce. If not against a Helpless or Stunned Character, Melee Attacks with this weapon gain a -30 To Hit.

misc_weapons.name: Heavy Duty Bolt Cutters
misc_weapons.description: 30 Penalty to Hit against moving Characters. Powerful bolt cutters, 1.3 meters long. Strong enough to cut through even Covenant metals and locks and can even lop off the fingers of any known Race. On Helpless or Stunned Characters that cannot fight back, Melee Attacks with Bolt Cutters deal 2D10 +14 Damage, with 18 Pierce. If not against a Helpless or Stunned Character, Melee Attacks with this weapon gain a -30 To Hit.

misc_weapons.name: Taser Gun
misc_weapons.description: Electrified (2D10), Sticky Special Rule. Uses Warfare Melee when Melee Reach and uses Warfare Range when being used as a projectile.

citation: Destiny: Light and Sky, Standard Melee Weapons, pp. 40-43
notes: price is in cR. Light Weapon Light Cost = price rounded up to the nearest 5.
Halberd Pierce is printed as 'Half Strength Modifier' with no base value; stored as 0.
